plugins.name: AI Connect (MCP)
plugins.author: A Studio
plugins.description: Connects A Studio to an AI assistant (Claude, Cursor...) through the astudio-mcp server: the AI can read the project, write notes, add channels and play. Adds an AI connection section in Settings.

plugins.name: Beat Tools
plugins.author: A Studio
plugins.description: Play/Stop button in the top bar, a menu item and a beat generator panel with tap tempo.

plugins.name: Chord Helper
plugins.author: A Studio
plugins.description: Panel that writes chords and arpeggios into the current channel, with presets saved on the device.

plugins.name: Poly Synth
plugins.author: A Studio
plugins.description: Resonant filter synth with wave choice, sub oscillator, drift button and factory presets.

plugins.name: Supersaw
plugins.author: A Studio
plugins.description: Seven detuned saws with filter and envelope.

plugins.name: Noise Snare
plugins.author: A Studio
plugins.description: One shot snare made of a tone and filtered noise.

plugins.name: Stereo Delay
plugins.author: A Studio
plugins.description: Delay synced to the tempo or free, ping pong, tone, Clear button and presets.

plugins.name: Bitcrusher
plugins.author: A Studio
plugins.description: Bit depth and sample rate reduction.
